scripts.build: npm run build -w @devcommunityit/ui && npm run build -w @devcommunityit/docs && npm run build -w @devcommunityit/ui-mcp
scripts.mcp: npm run build:mcp && npm run start -w @devcommunityit/ui-mcp
scripts.mcp:http: npm run build:mcp && npm run start:http -w @devcommunityit/ui-mcp
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint:css -w @devcommunityit/ui && npm run lint:tokens -w @devcommunityit/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @devcommunityit/ui && npm run typecheck -w @devcommunityit/docs && npm run typecheck -w @devcommunityit/ui-mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @devcommunityit/ui && npm run test -w @devcommunityit/ui-mcp
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:package && npm run verify:package && npm run test:e2e
